bull.claim: 94.6% CD ratio in FY26 hit the target range of 90% to 96%.
bull.why: Meeting targeted balance-sheet parameters preserves regulatory compliance and bolsters management credibility with investors.

bull.claim: 1.11% GNPA and 44 basis points credit costs were achieved in Q2 FY27.
bull.why: Contained non-performing assets and low provisioning requirements protect operating earnings from credit loss erosion.

bull.claim: 23.5% September '26 EOP loan growth was recorded for MSME and mid-market business.
bull.why: Expanding commercial loan volumes supports interest earning asset base growth and strengthens overall franchise profitability.

bull.claim: Rs 90,000 crores Q2 FY27 retail disbursements supported 11.2% September '26 annual growth.
bull.why: Accelerating disbursement volume expands higher-yielding retail book assets and bolsters diversified revenue streams.

bear.claim: 96.0% CD ratio in FY27 so far is behind pace for 85% to 90%.
bear.why: Lagging balance-sheet rebalancing increases structural funding costs and strains liquidity buffers.

bear.claim: 16.0% net margin in Q2 FY27 dropped −0.5 pp YoY.
bear.why: Margin compression reduces net interest spread income and impairs underlying banking franchise profitability.

bear.claim: +5.6% PAT to owners and +9.1% total income were reported in Q2 FY27.
bear.why: Decelerating profit expansion relative to income constrains capital generation and equity shareholder returns.
